{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hjaff constitution''' belonged to the [[Tarc]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hjaff]]. The Hjaff planetary leader&mdash;known as the ''[[Keddek]]''&mdash;was required to obey the Hjaff constitution. The constitution also provided for the three continental leaders to strip the ''Keddek'' of their position.
